content:
Platforms: Windows
Event sent when EAEP has determined a new scheduled task was modified to the local machine. The RPC data will be for the furthest 'hop' away in an RPC
connection. For instance, the 'at' command is 2 levels away from the schdsvc service.
RegPostObjectName is used for DFA enhancing other fields, and isn't part of this events cloudable definition.
